intro.cn: 在教室，白家月和陈天中在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the classroom, Bai Jiayue and Chen Tianzhong were chatting.

questions.q: 同学们想送给王老师什么？
同学们今天要去哪儿看看？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 时间过得真快啊！新年就要到了。
lines.en: Time flies! The New Year is almost here.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 这一年王老师教我们中文，每天工作都很累。
lines.en: This year, Ms. Wang has been teaching us Chinese, and she works so hard every day.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 是啊，她教得很好。因为她，我们都非常爱上中文课。
lines.en: Yes, she teaches very well. Because of her, we all love attending Chinese class.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 我们给她准备个新年礼物吧。你觉得送给她什么好呢？
lines.en: Let's prepare a New Year's gift for her. What do you think we can present to her?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 王老师喜欢花，就送给她花吧。
lines.en: Ms. Wang likes flowers. I think we can give her flowers.

lines.speaker: 陈天中
lines.cn: 那我们去花店看看，现在买花的人多，希望花店还有漂亮的花。
lines.en: Then let's go to the flower shop; there are many people buying flowers now. I hope there are still some beautiful flowers in the shop.

postQuestions.q: 同学们为什么爱上中文课？
陈天中希望花店现在还有什么？

intro.en: In the classroom, Wang Yifei was teaching.

questions.q: 今天的词比昨天多多少？

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 王老师，今天的词比昨天多了十个。
lines.en: Ms. Wang, today's vocabulary has ten more words than yesterday's.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 是啊！你们都学会了吗？
lines.en: Yes! Have you all learned them?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 学会了，没有问题。
lines.en: We've learned them. No problem.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 好。现在我来说，你们在本子上面写。
lines.en: Good. Now I'll say them, and you write them down in your notebooks.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 同学们，“洗手间”的“间”字写错了，它的里面是“日”，不是“口”。
lines.en: Class, the character “间” in “洗手间” is wrong. The part inside is “日”, not “口”.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: “日”比“口”多一笔，写“口”就是“问题”的“问”了。
lines.en: “日” has one more stroke than “口”. Writing “口” turns it into the “问” in “问题”.

lines.speaker: 王一飞
lines.cn: 没错，你说得很对。
lines.en: Yes, you are right.

postQuestions.q: 王老师让同学们在哪儿写字？

intro.cn: 在教室，安妮和白家月在聊天儿。
intro.en: In the classroom, Annie and Bai Jiayue were chatting.

questions.q: 这个本子是在哪儿买的？
安妮让白家月送给她什么礼物？

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 家月，你觉得这个本子怎么样？
lines.en: Jiayue, what do you think of this notebook?

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 很漂亮，多少钱一个？
lines.en: It's very pretty. How much is it?

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 比我们一起买的那个本子贵一点儿。
lines.en: It's a bit more expensive than the notebook we bought together.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 这么漂亮的本子，不可能贵一点儿吧？
lines.en: For such a beautiful notebook, it couldn't be just a little more expensive, right?

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 我是上网买的，真没那么贵。我买了两个，送你一个。
lines.en: I bought it online, and it's really not that expensive. I bought two and will give you one.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 谢谢！那我送给你什么呢？
lines.en: Thank you! Then what should I give you in return?

lines.speaker: 安妮
lines.cn: 咖啡杯吧，我最喜欢喝咖啡了。
lines.en: A coffee cup would be great. I like drinking coffee the most.

lines.speaker: 白家月
lines.cn: 好，那样我们就都有新年礼物了！
lines.en: Alright! Then we'll both have New Year's gifts!

postQuestions.q: 白家月觉得这个本子怎么样？
白家月和安妮都有新年礼物了吗？

title.en: Writing a diary in the room

intro.cn: 在房间，白家月在写日记。
intro.en: In the room, Bai Jiayue was writing in her diary.

questions.q: 判断正误：安妮送了白家月一个新年礼物。
判断正误：白家月送了王老师漂亮的花。

lines.cn: 新年就要到了，安妮送给我一个新本子。她告诉我是在网上买的，比我的本子贵一点儿。
lines.en: The New Year is almost here. Annie gave me a new notebook. She told me she bought it online, and it's a bit more expensive than mine.

lines.cn: 我们班同学也送了王老师漂亮的花，希望她高高兴兴地过个新年。
lines.en: Our classmates also gave Ms. Wang beautiful flowers, hoping she will have a happy New Year.

grammar.note: 双宾语句是一个动词带两个宾语的句子，一般前一个宾语指人，后一个宾语指事物。本课学习动词“拿、送、卖”加“给”构成的双宾语句。
grammar.noteEn: A double-object sentence is a sentence in which a verb takes two objects. Generally, the first object refers to a person, while the second object refers to a thing. In this lesson, we learn double-object sentences formed with the verbs “拿”, “送”, and “卖” combined with “给”.

items.c: 王老师喜欢花，就送给她花吧。
items.en: Ms. Wang likes flowers, so let's give her flowers.
She brought me a glass of water.
He sold me a Chinese book.

practice.cn: A：我想送给____，她会喜欢吗？ B：没问题，她的爱好就是读书。
A：昨天过生日，爸爸送____。 B：我看看。这个手机很好啊！
A：小雪，你爸爸回来了吗？ B：回来了，他还拿____

grammar.note: 用“比”表示的比较句中，数量短语放在形容词后面，表示具体差别。基本结构：A 比 B＋形容词＋数量短语。
grammar.noteEn: In comparative sentences using “比”, numeral-measure word phrases are placed after the adjective to indicate the specific difference. Basic structure: A 比 B + Adjective + Numeral-Measure Word Phrase.

items.c: 今天的词比昨天多了十个。
items.en: Today's vocabulary has ten more words than yesterday's.
My older sister is three years older than me.

items.c: 坐飞机比坐火车快五个多小时。
items.en: Taking a plane is more than five hours faster than taking a train.

practice.cn: A：今天你是几点起床的？ B：七点半，比昨天早____
A：这一课的汉字真多啊！ B：是啊，比第十课多____

grammar.note: 用“比”表示的比较句中，“一点儿”或“一些”用在形容词后面，表示差别不大。基本结构：A 比 B＋形容词＋一点儿/一些。
grammar.noteEn: In comparative sentences using “比”, “一点儿” or “一些” are placed after the adjective to indicate a small difference. Basic structure: A 比 B + Adjective + 一点儿/一些.

items.c: 比我们一起买的那个本子贵一点儿。
items.en: It's a bit more expensive than the notebook we bought together.
My older sister is a little taller than me.

items.c: 那间教室比这间大一些。
items.en: That classroom is a bit bigger than this one.

practice.cn: A：你觉得这条白色的裤子长不长？ B：____，那条黑色的____，还是买那条吧。
A：今天的苹果____昨天的____。 B：便宜的也很好吃。
A：姐姐的书和本子比我多，所以她的书包____ B：也比你的书包贵一点儿。

tips.note: 我们学过“咖啡”和“杯子”，猜一猜“咖啡杯”是什么意思。
tips.noteEn: We have learned the words “咖啡” and “杯子”; guess what “咖啡杯” means.

items.cn: 教室的门开着，但是____没有人。
A：小李呢？我找她有点儿事。 B：____去洗手间了。她回来后，我让她去找你。
A：姐姐，家月____我你已经接到她们了。谢谢你！ B：不客气，你的朋友就是我的朋友。

classroomActivity.description: 新年就要到了，两人一组，互相赠送礼物，并邀请对方来家里聚会，等等。尽可能使用本课所学生词和语法。
classroomActivity.descriptionEn: The New Year is approaching. Work in pairs and exchange gifts, invite your partner to a party at your home, and so on. Try to use the vocabulary and grammar learned in this lesson as much as possible.
